context.content: Okay, what follows is an opinion, but it's not without some experience--mine and others'--giving it weight. Dropbox is for convenience but should never be used as a backup system. They have had too many problems in the past, even recently, and files disappearing on the servers automatically means files gone on your hard drive when the client continues to mirror the server state. Anything you need safely backed up should be backed up using other means.
